runtimeSecurityRollout.tenantContext: trusted Gateway context plus repository RLS; request body and browser headers are never authoritative
runtimeSecurityRollout.population: exact legal entity and pay group; query may additionally use named population; the most restrictive decision wins
runtimeSecurityRollout.fieldProjection: PAY_INPUT, PAY_RESULT, PAY_RESULT_MASKED, TAX_LIMITED, BANK_PAYMENT, PAY_STATEMENT, or COMMAND_RECEIPT only as allocated per operation
runtimeSecurityRollout.stepUp: cryptographic one-time evidence bound to the exact public method and path for approve and finalize only
runtimeSecurityRollout.idempotency: tenant, subject, originating action, and idempotency key bind an immutable request digest; exact replay returns the original receipt and mismatch fails closed
runtimeSecurityRollout.optimisticConcurrency: every command requires expectedVersion and stale CAS fails without side effects
runtimeSecurityRollout.recovery: lease expiry and durable checkpoints permit one fenced worker to resume or reconcile; duplicate facts and duplicate minimized events are forbidden

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Calculation accepts only an immutable frozen snapshot whose PAY-016 source rows, snapshot revision, payload digest, formula-set digest, and target population digest are pinned before attempt creation.
The same canonical input and engine version produce byte-equivalent monetary results, trace digests, control totals, and resultDigest across replay.
An exact idempotent retry returns the original command receipt; reuse with a different canonical request digest fails closed and creates no attempt or outbox event.
expectedVersion CAS fences calculate, approve, and finalize so stale commands have no side effects.
Wrong tenant, legal entity, pay group, named population, purpose, capability, action, or field projection is denied before domain data is disclosed; cross-scope reads are opaque.
A calculation command creates one monotonically numbered attempt and follows READY to CALCULATING to VALIDATED, FAILED, or RESULT_UNKNOWN with an immutable status history.
Worker crash, expired lease, checkpoint retry, and broker or database uncertainty recover without duplicate worker results, result lines, traces, receipts, or PayrollCalculated events.
RESULT_UNKNOWN is never silently treated as success or rerun; reconciliation proves the durable outcome or creates a forward recovery attempt linked to its predecessor.
Successful result facts and calculation traces are append-only; correction supersedes through a new run or attempt and never rewrites finalized monetary facts.
Approval and finalization require exact capability, fresh path-bound step-up, expectedVersion, and maker-checker separation; each writes an atomic receipt, audit record, and minimized event.
Command receipt query re-evaluates current entitlement, originating action, subject, population, field policy, and purpose, and returns opaque 404 for cross-tenant or out-of-scope receipts.

V50 passes clean and V49-to-V50 upgrade checks with forced tenant RLS and immutable facts; the command-center journey covers loading, empty, denied, partial failure, stale, retry, keyboard, responsive, high-contrast, reduced-motion, and 200-percent zoom states while the feature remains OFF.
